title.narrative: Fortalecimiento de los sistemas de derechos humanos en El Salvador
Strengthening Human Rights Systems in El Salvador

description.narrative: USAID/El Salvador brindará intervenciones que protejan o respondan a los abusos de derechos humanos y fortalezcan las instituciones locales de derechos humanos, incluida la Fiscalía General. [CARSI]
USAID/El Salvador will provide interventions that protect against or respond to human rights abuses and strengthen local human rights institutions, including the Attorney General's Office. [CARSI]
